title: Promote Route Guardian toward Boot Gate v1 through candidate shell testing
reason: The one-button Route Guardian manual test passed. The next clean stage is to test Route Guardian as a boot gate in a candidate copy of the real current shell before considering any change to pmp-app-current.html.
promotion_goal: Route Guardian Boot Gate v1 should check the current route before loading PMP World, then change the primary button/action to open PMP Current only after route proof passes.
required_candidate_behavior: Open as a candidate shell, not the real Home Screen shell.
Primary button starts as Check Route.
After route pass, primary button changes to Open PMP Current or Load PMP Current.
Candidate shell must load the same current map target as pmp-app-current.html.
Candidate shell must not change pmp-current-map.json.
Candidate shell must not redirect automatically before user action.
Candidate shell must not delete, archive, or write app files.
must_not_change: Safe Writer / Code Safety / Hard Fresh routes
test_battery_required_for_candidate: Confirm Route Guardian appears before PMP World.
Confirm primary button changes to Open PMP Current after pass.
Tap Copy Report and verify it copies or displays report.
Tap Open PMP Current and confirm PMP loads.
Confirm PMP tabs are usable and not blocked by Route Guardian controls.
Confirm Bug Memory clean route still opens from PMP.
Confirm no app route files changed.
rollback_plan: If candidate fails, do not patch pmp-app-current.html.
Keep pmp-route-guardian-v1.js as manual/support test only.
Use previous working test page pmp-route-guardian-test-v1.html for manual route proof.
No restore needed unless a future step modifies real app files.
blocked_by: Candidate shell not tested on user device yet.
next_action: Build pmp-app-current-route-guardian-candidate.html as a candidate copy of the real shell.
